name: VibeWave v2.4.6 - Mega Feature Update: Volume Booster, Car Mode, Desi EQ & Data Saver
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.6 - Ultimate Feature Drop!

- 🔊 **Volume Booster (+150% / +200%):** Badhayein apne speaker aur earphone ki aawaz ko +200% tak with anti-clipping protection!
- 🚗 **Car Driving Mode:** Gaadi chalate waqt asani se chalayein with giant touch buttons, large album art and safe controls!
- 🎛️ **Desi Equalizer Presets:** Desi Dholak & Bass, Ghazal & Vocal Clarity, Bhakti & Flute, aur Desi Party & EDM presets!
- 👆 **MiniPlayer Swipe Gestures:** Mini player par left/right swipe karke agla ya pichhla gaana badlein!
- 📉 **Data Saver Mode:** 70% tak mobile internet data bachayein!
